text: Not all giants walk the land... some crash into cliffs.
hint: You won’t need a jet to find this Maverick, but the waves still fly high.

solved.title: Mavericks
solved.body: Awesome job! You made it to the infamous big-wave surf spot, Mavericks.
solved.facts: Mavericks wasn’t named after a person... it was named after a dog! Maverick, a white-haired German Shepherd, used to wait on the shore while his owner surfed nearby. He became such a familiar presence that surfers eventually named the legendary surf spot after him!

text: No curtains, no lights... just sand, sea, and sky performing on nature’s stage.
hint: It's called Francis, but don’t expect a sermon... this beachside stage speaks in wind and waves.

solved.title: Francis Beach Amphitheater
solved.body: Welcome to the Francis Beach Amphitheater, a hidden gem nestled within the natural treasure of Half Moon Bay State Beach.
solved.facts: During Prohibition and into World War II, the wide sand and hidden coves of Francis Beach were used by smugglers to unload contraband liquor, and later served as a strategic military post to guard against potential threats off the Pacific coast. Today, it’s used for park ranger programs and educational talks.
